quest.title: O Shrine, Show Your Power Once Again!
quest.description: Having seemingly obtained a reply from a deity, Shouta hopes that the shrine can show its power once again...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Nice! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go check out the shrine at Komore Teahouse first.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: #{F#Big sis}{M#Big bro}! Listen! Listen!

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: After I made an offering to the shrine from last time, my wish was granted... a small part of it, at least! But although it's just a small part... this must be the archon's answer, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What was your wish?

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Uhh... the wish I made last time was for the creator of the manga I'm reading to be more productive. Having one update every two days would be best!

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: And then, the creator actually did double the amount of updated content in one issue!

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: However... I've also heard that he's gonna take a break for 3 issues.

choices.text: Perfectly balanced, as all things should be, I guess...?

response.speaker: Shouta
response.text: Hmm... anyway, I'm sure the archon heard my wishes. That means that the reason why they were not realized is that I didn't offer enough things!

response.speaker: Shouta
response.text: So we're going to make an offering to other shrines today! This way, I'm sure my wishes will be granted completely!

response.speaker: Shouta
response.text: I have asked my parents, and they say that there are still two shrines around here. One is near Komore Teahouse, and the other one is on the way out of the city.

response.speaker: Shouta
response.text: #Which shrine do you think we should go to first, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}?

choices.text: Feels like you'll be short one issue overall...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: This is the place.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: I heard that a Doushin made an offering of many paper cranes here a long, long time ago, wishing that everyone at Hanamizaka can live peacefully.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Soon after, a fire broke out nearby, and a house caught on fire. However, that house was built with shoddy materials anyway, so the fire finished it off really quickly, and it couldn't spread at all...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Everybody believes that this was the archon's protection... Hehe, that's why I've also folded some paper cranes and brought them here.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: And that's enough chitchat! What should we offer this time then?

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: We might get a response if we offer paper cranes, just like that Doushin.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: But since this shrine is near the teahouse, would it be better if we make an offering of matcha-flavored Konpeito candies?

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Yeah, and matcha-flavored Konpeito candies are things I like, too...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: #What do you think, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}?

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Well, this is the place.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: A long time ago, someone made an offering to this shrine with Iron Ore used for forging blades, hoping that his martial arts skills could improve quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Later on, that guy went to a martial arts tournament and defeated every adversary super easy! Everyone commended his outstanding martial skills.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: However, according to him, none of his opponents seemed to be feeling too good...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: It feels like the archon doesn't have very clear standards...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: But anyway, everyone thinks that the archon did it. That's why I think we'll get a response if we make a wish at this shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Well, that aside, what should we offer this time?

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Just like that guy, maybe we can get some response if we offer Iron Ore!

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: I found some near the entrance of the blacksmith's. However, they don't look all that good, which is probably why the blacksmith didn't mind giving them to me.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: I've also gathered some fresh seagrass from around here. If I cook them and sprinkle some sugar... they'll surely taste amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: I'm just not sure if the archon likes this kind of small, cold dishes...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: #What do you think, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Iron ores then.
